attchmntText: CDSL has informed the Exchange about Schedule of Analyst Call with J.P. Morgan India Emerging Opportunities Forum to be held on Thursday, November 19, 2026
voiceSummary: Central Depository Services India Limited has scheduled an Analyst Investor Conference Call for Thursday November 19 2026. The meeting is with J.P. Morgan India Emerging Opportunities Forum. It is a group meeting held virtually in Mumbai. The session starts at 12.00 PM and ends at 01.00 PM. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared. This disclosure is under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: CDSL has informed the Exchange about Schedule of Analyst Call with Avendus Spark INDX: Annual Investor Conference to be held on Wednesday, November 18, 2026
voiceSummary: Central Depository Services India Limited has scheduled an Analyst Investor Conference Call for Wednesday November 18 2026. The event is the Avendus Spark INDX Annual Investor Conference held in Mumbai. The meeting is a group session starting at 10.00 AM and ending at 01.00 PM. The company notes that the schedule is subject to change due to exigencies. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared with analysts or institutional investors. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. The information is also available on the company website at www.cdslindia.com. Nilay Shah Company Secretary and Compliance Officer signed the notice.

attchmntText: CDSL has informed the Exchange about Schedule of Analyst Call with JM Financial Annual India Conference - India Xchange 2026 to be held on Tuesday, November 17, 2026
voiceSummary: Central Depository Services India Limited has scheduled an Analyst and Investor Conference Call for Tuesday, November 17, 2026. The event is the JM Financial Annual India Conference, specifically India Xchange 2026. The meeting will take place in Mumbai. The scheduled time is from 10.00 A.M. to 01.00 P.M. The company notes that this schedule is subject to change due to exigencies. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during the meeting. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. The information is also available on the company website at www.cdslindia.com. Nilay Shah, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the notice.

attchmntText: CDSL has informed the Exchange about Schedule of Analyst Call with Non-Deal Road Show organised by HDFC Securities Limited to be held on Friday, November 13, 2026
voiceSummary: Central Depository Services India Limited has scheduled an Analyst and Investor Conference Call for Friday, November 13, 2026. The event is a Non-Deal Road Show organized by HDFC Securities Limited. The meeting will take place as a Group Meeting in London. The scheduled time is from 11.00 A.M. to 02.00 P.M.
